category_review.locator: PDF p81, material information for recyclers; supplier list PDF p30, p37
category_review.rationale: The back cover (FP4-BATTERY-COVER) is listed as 13.65 g polycarbonate; the supplier list groups suppliers by the type of components they produce (supplier list PDF p30) and lists 7 under Plastics. Possible supplier group for this item; no listed supplier is shown to make it.

category_review.locator: PDF p80, material information for recyclers; supplier list PDF p30, p38
category_review.rationale: The mid frame (including buttons) holds 30.61 g aluminium, 98% of the phone's aluminium; the supplier list groups suppliers by the type of components they produce (supplier list PDF p30) and lists 11 under Shields, Metal Parts, Screws, including an aluminium extruder. Possible supplier group; no listed supplier is shown to make it.

category_review.locator: PDF p81, material information for recyclers; supplier list PDF p30, p37
category_review.rationale: The mid frame includes a 6.30 g polycarbonate middle housing (FP4-MIDDLE-HOUSING); the supplier list groups suppliers by the type of components they produce (supplier list PDF p30) and lists 7 under Plastics. Possible supplier group; no listed supplier is shown to make it.

category_review.locator: PDF p11, p15; supplier list PDF p30, p36
category_review.rationale: The rear cameras are a replaceable camera module; the supplier list groups suppliers by the type of components they produce (supplier list PDF p30) and lists one under Cameras. Possible supplier group; one recorded supplier is not evidence of single sourcing.

category_review.locator: PDF p3, p15; supplier list PDF p30, p36
category_review.rationale: The selfie camera (25MP) is a replaceable camera module; the supplier list groups suppliers by the type of components they produce (supplier list PDF p30) and lists one under Cameras. Possible supplier group; one recorded supplier is not evidence of single sourcing.

category_review.locator: PDF p8; supplier list PDF p30, p34
category_review.rationale: The earpiece is the top speaker; the supplier list groups suppliers by the type of components they produce (supplier list PDF p30) and lists 6 under Electromechanical, MEMS, a group that also covers MEMS and other components. Possible supplier group; no listed supplier is shown to make it.

category_review.locator: PDF p16, p80; supplier list PDF p30, p34
category_review.rationale: The loudspeaker assembly contains the vibration motor; the supplier list groups suppliers by the type of components they produce (supplier list PDF p30) and lists 6 under Electromechanical, MEMS. Possible supplier group; the source does not place the SLS1115D speaker in this assembly.

category_review.locator: PDF p16; supplier list PDF p30, p35
category_review.rationale: The USB-C port is a replaceable module; the supplier list groups suppliers by the type of components they produce (supplier list PDF p30) and lists 3 under Connectors, Clips, Spring Contacts, Cables. Possible supplier group; none is shown to make this port.

case.scope: Bounded Fairphone 4 public-document reconstruction, enriched from two retained Fairphone documents. Structure: the 13 items of the earlier public reconstruction plus 3 key components from the 2022 repairer key-component table. Suppliers: 75 organisations; 7 item-level associations (final assembly and six key components) and 74 category-level associations across 12 supplier categories from the November 2021 supplier list, with 74 reported sites. Not a complete or certified production BOM; exact revision, quantities and buyers are not established. Supplier links are historical (2021-2022), not current contracts, exclusive sources or buyer relationships. Organisations are not merged across documents except where stated in a link's note. Smelters and refiners (Annex 2) are not included. Item-to-category classifications: 11, all researcher-derived (3 carried from the earlier public reconstruction and 8 added in v0.2 after review); a classification says the item is the kind of component a supplier group produced, not that any listed supplier made it. Every statement carries a status in the assertion audit.

assertion_audit.subject: <https://example.org/supply-chain-resilience/case/fairphone4/enriched/v0.2/bom>
assertion_audit.object: "Bounded Fairphone 4 public-document reconstruction, enriched from two retained Fairphone documents. Structure: the 13 items of the earlier public reconstruction plus 3 key components from the 2022 repairer key-component table. Suppliers: 75 organisations; 7 item-level associations (final assembly and six key components) and 74 category-level associations across 12 supplier categories from the November 2021 supplier list, with 74 reported sites. Not a complete or certified production BOM; exact revision, quantities and buyers are not established. Supplier links are historical (2021-2022), not current contracts, exclusive sources or buyer relationships. Organisations are not merged across documents except where stated in a link's note. Smelters and refiners (Annex 2) are not included. Item-to-category classifications: 11, all researcher-derived (3 carried from the earlier public reconstruction and 8 added in v0.2 after review); a classification says the item is the kind of component a supplier group produced, not that any listed supplier made it. Every statement carries a status in the assertion audit."^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string>
assertion_audit.rationale: Carries the provenance of its input record (bom); v0.1 had no statement-level audit.
